title: fix: make polli text output consistent across modes
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes #15440 by registering `--stream` and using TTY auto-detection only when neither stream flag is passed.
- Refs #15438: reports the server model and token count from streamed events, with `null` when unavailable.
- Refs #15442: emits JSON file metadata after `gen text --output`.
- Adds command regression tests; CLI package suite passed (189 tests).
- Quest accounting: only #15440 and #15439 are PR-closing reports in this batch; the other reports are linked and closed manually.

gist.headline: The CLI found its voice
gist.blurb: Polli's text command now behaves the same whether it is chatting with a terminal, streaming on purpose, or writing to a file. The little bee also brings back useful receipts: model, tokens, and output-file metadata.
gist.summary: Fixed `polli gen text` stream-mode handling by registering `--stream`, applying TTY auto-detection only when no stream flag is supplied, reporting streamed server model and token counts when available, and emitting JSON file metadata after `--output`.
gist.impact: CLI users now get predictable text output across interactive and scripted modes, plus machine-readable output-file details and streamed model/token information instead of having to infer them.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful terminal operator choosing between two clearly labeled stream paths while a cozy CRT terminal prints a neat text response. A small JSON receipt and a file card show the returned model and token count, with code-plants and flowers making the command-line workshop feel organized rather than bureaucratic.
